description: Issue a new document-signing envelope. The Worker pins the document body to IPFS (via ipfs-pinner), writes the `com.etzhayyim.esign.envelope` record to MST, and notifies every signer DID through `app.bsky.feed.post` mentions plus a `wproto.convo` thread. Charter purpose tag MUST be set; `general` is reserved for low-stakes internal documents only.

requesterDid.description: DID of the principal issuing the envelope. MUST match the authenticated session DID.

documentBase64.description: Base64-encoded canonical document body. Worker pins this to IPFS and stores only the CID + sha256 on the envelope record.

documentMimeType.description: MIME type of the document. Default `application/pdf`.

purpose.description: Charter-aligned purpose tag. Commodity-flow values (`donation-in-kind`, `internal-allocation`, `surplus-routing`, `operational-supply`) require `requesterAgentAuthorityRef` when the requester is an AAT-bound agent (per ADR-2605231500).

requesterAgentAuthorityRef.description: AT URI of the AAT (`com.etzhayyim.agent.authority`) backing this request. Required when the requester is an AI agent; the Worker verifies the AAT scope covers the requested purpose + (if applicable) UNSPSC subject classifications. Per ADR-2605231500.

subjectClassifications.description: Optional classification-system subjects this envelope is about. Persists onto `envelope.subjectClassifications`.

commodityManifestUri.description: Optional AT URI of an existing commodityManifest record. If absent and `subjectClassifications` describes a UNSPSC batch, the Worker creates the manifest record from the agent-supplied items array.

customsRef.description: Optional AT URI of the customs declaration record. Required when the matching UNSPSC processManifest has customsRequired=true.

councilMirror.description: Force geth-private mirror anchoring. Auto-true when `purpose` is council-resolution / land-donation / force-rd-consent / public-fund-disbursement.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the envelope auto-expires. Default 14.

errors.name: InvalidSigner
errors.description: One or more signer DIDs are not resolvable, or lack the required membership tier.

errors.name: DocumentTooLarge
errors.description: Document exceeds 8 MiB. Use the chunked pin path (not yet implemented in Phase 0).

errors.name: CharterViolation
errors.description: Purpose tag conflicts with Charter Rider §2 — for example, an advertising or for-profit-sale document.

errors.name: InvalidAgentAuthority
errors.description: requesterAgentAuthorityRef is missing, revoked, expired, or its scope does not cover the requested purpose / UNSPSC subjects.

errors.name: CharterAttestationFailed
errors.description: ChartersComplianceRegistry attestation lookup failed (no current attestation covers this purpose + classification).

errors.name: SanctionsDeny
errors.description: Sanctions screening of the counterparty or destination returned a deny.

errors.name: ForceAuthorizationRequired
errors.description: UNSPSC processManifest marks this code as force-sensitive but ForceAuthorization.preAttest() has not been satisfied.

errors.name: CouncilEscalationRequired
errors.description: Envelope value/count exceeds the per-commodity councilEscalationThreshold; requester-only signing not permitted — submit via Council multisig path.
